страна.consejo: It is the general word for any country.

париж.consejo: «zh» is the voiced sound of ж, like the «s» in «measure»; it is not a «sh».

время.consejo: It is a neuter noun ending in -мя; in the genitive it is «времени».

trad.en: it is needed; one has to

свой.consejo: It agrees with the thing possessed and refers to something belonging to the subject: «my/your/his/her own», depending on the context.

trad.en: sister (dative: «to the sister»; prepositional: «about the sister»)

одна.consejo: With «одна», the noun is in the singular.

мало.consejo: With countable nouns in the plural, the genitive is used: «мало друзей» (few friends). The opposite is «много».

около.consejo: In front of a noun it means «near» and takes the genitive: «около города» (near the city).

трое.consejo: A collective numeral, commonly used with дети: «трое детей» = three children.

англия.consejo: England is one of the countries that make up the United Kingdom; it is not the name of the whole United Kingdom.

америка.consejo: The meaning depends on the context: it can name the continent or, colloquially, the United States.

офис.consejo: It sounds a lot like the English word «office», and it is very common at work.

компания.consejo: It can also be translated as «company» when it means a business.

институт.consejo: It can be a higher education or research centre; it does not necessarily mean that it is smaller than a university.

учить.consejo: With a subject: **учить русский язык**. With a person, it can mean to teach: **учить студентов**.

о.consejo: The form depends on the initial sound: о работе, об истории, but о Елене.

вдвоём.consejo: A fixed word: it never changes.

втроём.consejo: The same as «вдвоём», but with three.
